main_text.p: His vbi tam vul stoltdas rumoribus aures Imbuerat,parat Exorcismum,circulus ingens Ducitur,hunc intra spatio breuiore minores: In medio stabat palu,iuxtáque catinus Plenus aqua.sed cuꝫ cineréque salémque sacerdos Addiderat multo cum murmure,nec sine anhelis Flatibus.hoc postquam scena est instructa paratu, Langiu ipse pater sacro venerandus amistu, Circum omnem irrorat setosi aspergine scepiri, Verbáque pracipiu contoriuplicata rotatu Conuoluens,cœlum ac terras adiurat,& vndas, Et tremefasta imis Acherontia regna cauernis.

Et tam nox aderat secreti conscia sacri, Iámque è vicinis populus conuenerat agris, Matres atque viri,pueri innuptaq; puella, Scire auidi quò tanta cadant promissa, nisi ille Conscia secreti formidans lumina & aures Esse procul magna iussisset voce profanos: Quiue sacerdoti nonilla luce diserte Cunctla sufurrasset tacituram crimina in aurem: Laica ne trepidi fugiant commercia manes, Neue inhians prada vel seiunus cacodæmon Inuolet,& laceret sceleratorum vnguibus artus.

Ducitur ad palum velut hosti a rusticus ipse; Fista quidem gnarus cuncta,at formidine tanta Attonitus,quàm si Stygia egressurus ab aluo Aspiciat nudas mandentem Cerberon vmbras, Siue animo timor à puero conceptu,anilcs Fabella haud modicus pueris ploranibus horror, Siue locus fumo,& caca caligine opacus, Et velut inferna terrebat imago culina.

page.notes: Printed text is in a mixed Roman/italic face with long s and ligatures; several words are doubtful (e.g. "stoltdas", "langiu", "Attonitus", "culina"). Some words are stained and read with uncertainty; none were marked with [?] individually. Catchword "Sed" is set at the lower right.
